name: ZooMeet – Zoom Meeting & Webinar Integration | Dedicated Zoom Video Conference Solution for WordPress
author: Sovlix

sections.description:
🔥 Get ZooMeet PRO | 🤝 Join Community | 🕹️ YouTube

Power up your virtual meetings, webinars, and online classes by integrating Zoom Meeting with ZooMeet: the dedicated Zoom Video Conference Plugin for WordPress.

Elevate your online meeting experience with ZooMeet – the ultimate Zoom integration solution for WordPress. ZooMeet is designed to help you create instant meetings and webinars without ever leaving your WordPress dashboard.

🏆 Key Features at a Glance:

✅ Dedicated Zoom Integration

ZooMeet offers a comprehensive Zoom meeting integration, empowering you to manage all your virtual meetings and webinars right from your WordPress site.

  • Effortlessly Manage Zoom Users: Create and manage Zoom users directly from WordPress.
  • Access Detailed Reports: Track and analyze meeting participation.
  • List and Access Recordings: View and share Zoom recordings with your audience.
  • Personal Meeting IDs: Securely use your personal Zoom ID for recurring sessions.
  • View Registrants: Monitor attendee registrations for webinars from the frontend.

✅ WooCommerce Integration

Monetize your webinars, meetings, and online events with WooCommerce Integration. Whether you’re selling consultation services, virtual courses, or tickets to webinars, ZooMeet makes it easy to connect and manage your Zoom meetings with WooCommerce.

  • Sell Meetings as Products: Create WooCommerce products linked to your Zoom meetings.
  • Automated Meeting Delivery: Automatically send meeting links and passwords to customers after purchase confirmation.
  • WooCommerce Booking Support: Automatically generate a Zoom meeting whenever a booking or appointment is confirmed.

✅ Multi-Vendor Support

Empower your marketplace vendors to manage their own Zoom meetings and webinars with Multi-Vendor Support. This feature integrates seamlessly with top multi-vendor plugins.

  • Vendor Independence: Each vendor can create and manage their own Zoom sessions.
  • Dokan Integration: Full support for Dokan dashboard to manage Zoom meetings.
  • WCFM Marketplace: Vendors can schedule and host Zoom sessions directly from WCFM.
  • MultivendorX: Seamless integration for vendors to sell and manage virtual events.

✅ LMS Integration

Take online learning to the next level with ZooMeet’s LMS Integration. Schedule and host Zoom meetings directly within your LMS dashboard.

  • Tutor LMS: Full frontend support for instructors to create, manage, and attach Zoom meetings to lessons and courses.
  • LifterLMS: Seamlessly integrate Zoom live sessions into your courses and lessons.
  • Academy LMS: Effortlessly link live Zoom sessions to interactive online learning modules.
  • LearnPress: Enable instructors to manage Zoom meetings directly from the frontend.

✅ Booking Integration

Streamline your scheduling with Booking Integration. ZooMeet works with popular booking plugins to ensure Zoom meetings are automatically created for every confirmed appointment.

  • Real-Time Sync: Automatically create Zoom meetings based on booking confirmations.
  • WooCommerce Booking Compatibility: Works seamlessly to automate your virtual appointments.

✅ Customizable & User-Friendly

  • Gutenberg & Elementor Support: Dedicated blocks and widgets to simplify Zoom meeting management.
  • Fully Customizable Shortcodes: Embed Zoom meetings, webinars, or recordings anywhere on your site.
  • Table & Board Views: Flexible layout options for your meeting list.

✅ 🔥 More Additional Features

  • Custom Meeting Thumbnails: Brand your sessions with custom images.
  • Countdown Timers: Build anticipation for upcoming webinars.
  • Duplicate Meetings: Quickly replicate existing Zoom sessions to save time.
  • Detailed Reports: Track participation and analyze engagement directly in WordPress.
  • Secure Meetings: Password-protected Zoom sessions for maximum privacy.

🔥 Get ZooMeet PRO | 🤝 Join Community | 🕹️ YouTube

📢 Hear From Our Users

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
“The best Zoom integration for WordPress! It saved me so much time managing my online classes.”
– Happy User

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/zoomeet directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to ZooMeet settings to configure your Zoom API credentials.
  4. Start creating and managing your Zoom meetings.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0 – 02 March 2026

  • Feature: Now exclusively focused on Zoom for a superior, dedicated experience.
  • Fix: Fixed critical Zoom host retrieval issue where “No hosts found” error appeared despite valid connection.
  • Enhancement: Improved Zoom Direct Meeting and Webinar block with better UI parity and missing labels.
  • Enhancement: Updated meeting list visibility logic to default to “Show All” for improved admin experience.
  • Refactor: Rebuilt frontend and Gutenberg block assets for better performance.
  • New: Added full integration support for LifterLMS.
  • New: Redesigned Settings UI with a modern dashboard and “Connected” status badge.
  • New: Added OAuth redirect URL copy utility for streamlined configuration.
  • Improved: Enhanced token management and automated session regeneration.
  • Fixed: Resolved recurring meeting display bugs and optimized WooCommerce integration.

1.1.2 – 24 November 2025

  • Minor bug fixes and improvements.

1.1.1 – 25 September 2025

  • Updated Freemius SDK

1.1.0 – 03 Jul, 2025

  • New: Introduced several new features

1.0.0

  • Initial release
